title: 第11章 需求太恐怖第12章 超乎想象的霸道
content_zh:
林北立即拿出五十块灵币，买下了这批丹药。
看着他如获至宝的样子，何掌柜百思不得其解。
那些残损丹药白给他都不想要，这年轻人竟然跟占了大便宜似的，真让人搞不懂！
“呵呵，公子慧眼独具，日后必成大器，下次再来光顾本店啊！”
林玄带着丹药，迅速离开了白雾城。
没过多久，药老和萧火火也来到了城外。
“找到了，小姐，他就在前面！”
“桀桀，看你往哪里逃？”
萧火火兴奋地搓着手掌，桀桀怪笑的表情，跟她那极美的容貌形成巨大的反差。
她终于能见到对方的真面目了。
对方若不识相，她不介意动用一些手段，套出那些丹药的来历。
两人加快速度，来到一片密林之前。
“公子出来吧，我家小姐要见你一面！”药老开口，脸上带着凝视的笑容。
没有反应！
萧火火脸色一沉：“小子，我数到三，再不滚出来，老娘扒光了你，三！”
“……”药老一脸黑线。
自家这位小姐天赋超卓、血脉强大、姿色绝佳、身材火辣，唯一的缺点就是性子急、脾气大，而且很虎。
也许真是被老主人惯坏了吧？
“小姐稍安勿躁，还是让老朽‘请’他出来吧！”
药力掠进林中，顿时愣住。

里面并没有他要找的人，只有一块贵宾令牌躺在草窝里！
“小姐，都怪我，没想到我一个老头子，竟被那后生给算到了！”
萧火火不怒反笑：“能让药老吃瘪的人着实不多，而能让我如此好奇的人，也是第一个，呵，有趣！”
“小姐，你不要乱来呀！”药老脸上浮现惊恐之色。
以他对小姐的了解，这是暴风雨来临的征兆！
果不其然！
萧火火眼中狞色一闪：“给脸不要脸，是你逼我的，药老，立即随我攻打天玄宗！！”
萧火火立即腾空而起，化作一道长虹就要遁走。
下一刻却被药老祭出的灵符罩住，带着她飞回了白雾城。
“啊啊啊！药老，你竟敢背叛我？！”
药老：“……”
“小姐不要任性！天玄宗跟咱们多有生意往来，为防家主震怒，咱们再另想办法！”
“呵，也好，事情变得更加有趣了！小子，今天算你逃过一劫，但一时的逃脱，只会换来更加猛烈的风暴，你在天玄宗给老娘洗白白等着吧！”
……
此时的林玄，并未返回天玄宗。
而是换了一个方向，来到了白雾城外一座偏僻的山谷中。
他要修复那批“可造之材”，尽快提升实力！
天地洪炉被他催动到三尺多高，八十多颗丹药全部倒了进去。
因为身处荒山，无需担心被人窥探，所以林玄并未收敛洪炉的力量。
结果祭炼刚一开始，便出现了意外。

轰！
伴着一声巨响，洪炉表面的金色符文爆发出炽烈的金光，将整个山谷照亮。
恐怖的高温以洪炉为中心向外扩散，将方圆十几丈的草木化为灰烬！
林玄脸色一变，连忙收敛洪炉的力量，出手扑灭了余火。
content_en:
Lin Bei immediately took out fifty spiritual coins and bought this batch of pills.
Seeing him as if he had found a treasure, Shopkeeper He was puzzled.
He didn't even want the damaged elixirs given to him for free. This young man actually seemed to have taken advantage of them. It was really puzzling!
"Haha, the young master has a unique insight and will become a great person in the future. Please come to our store again next time!"
Lin Xuan quickly left Baiwu City with the elixir.
Not long after, Yao Lao and Xiao Huohuo also arrived outside the city.
"Found it, miss, he is right in front!"
"Jiejie, where are you running away from?"
Xiao Huohuo rubbed her palms together excitedly. Jie Jie's weird smile was in huge contrast with her extremely beautiful appearance.
She could finally see the other person's true face.
If the other party doesn't understand, she doesn't mind using some means to find out the origin of those pills.
The two speeded up and came to a dense forest.
"Master, come out, my lady wants to see you!" Yao Lao said, with a staring smile on his face.
No response!
Xiao Huohuo's face darkened: "Boy, I'll count to three, if you don't get out, I'll strip you naked, three!"
"..." Yao Lao had a dark look on his face.
This young lady of my own is extremely talented, has strong blood, has great looks, and has a hot figure. Her only shortcoming is that she is short-tempered, has a bad temper, and is very aggressive.
Maybe he was really spoiled by his old master?
"Miss, please be patient and let the old man 'invite' him to come out!"
The medicinal power swept into the forest, and he was stunned.
There was no one he was looking for inside, only a VIP token lying on the grass nest!
"Miss, it's all my fault. I didn't expect that an old man like me would be tricked by that young man!"
Xiao Huohuo smiled instead of being angry: "There are not many people who can make Yao Lao feel depressed, but the person who can make me so curious is also the first one, ha, interesting!"
"Miss, don't mess around!" A look of horror appeared on Yao Lao's face.
Based on his understanding of the lady, this is a sign of the coming storm!
Sure enough!
A ferocious look flashed in Xiao Huohuo's eyes: "You're shameless, you forced me to do it, Yao Lao, follow me to attack Tianxuan Sect immediately!!"
Xiao Huohuo immediately rose into the sky and turned into a rainbow to escape.
The next moment, she was covered by the spiritual talisman sacrificed by Yao Lao and flew back to Baiwu City with her.
"Ah! Yao Lao, how dare you betray me?!"
Yao Lao: "..."
"Miss, don't be willful! Tianxuan Sect has a lot of business dealings with us. To prevent the family head from being angry, let's find another way!"
"Haha, that's good, things are getting more interesting! Boy, you have escaped today, but your temporary escape will only lead to a more violent storm. You can wait in Tianxuan Sect to save my life!"
…
At this time, Lin Xuan had not returned to Tianxuan Sect.
Instead, they changed directions and came to a remote valley outside Baiwu City.
He wants to repair those "manufacturable materials" and improve his strength as soon as possible!
He moved the furnace of heaven and earth to a height of more than three feet, and poured more than eighty pills into it.
Because he was in a barren mountain and there was no need to worry about being spied on, Lin Xuan did not restrain Hong Lu's power.
As a result, as soon as the sacrifice began, something unexpected happened.
boom!
With a loud noise, the golden runes on the surface of the furnace burst into blazing golden light, illuminating the entire valley.
The terrifying high temperature spread outwards from the center of the furnace, turning vegetation in a radius of more than ten feet into ashes!
Lin Xuan's expression changed, and he quickly gathered the power of the furnace and put out the remaining fire.
